name: Taco Bell Cheesy Roll-Up
whyItWorks: A warm, soft flour tortilla rolled around melted three-cheese blend (cheddar, mozzarella, and pepper jack in tiny proportion). Completely free from hot peppers, onions, beans, crunchy shells, or greasy beef.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order: "Cheesy Roll-Up, no sauce, nothing extra." A simple, gentle emergency road snack.
